about: Front ID0: Indonesian strings that may equal their English source, each with a reason (plan front-i18n-id.md §5.4). Keys are the lint's string ids: `catalog:<key>`, `map:<id>.<path>`, `original:<normalised original>`.

entries.catalog:app.name: product name (OpenVireo)
entries.catalog:instructorMode.optionsClosedOk: the same word in Indonesian (OK, as Windows Indonesian writes it)
entries.map:appShell.toolsMenu: the same word in Indonesian (Menu), the phone menu button
entries.map:helpMenu.ok: the same word in Indonesian (OK, as Windows Indonesian writes it)
